about: Synthetic HL7v2 sample messages for PulseBridge (task T07). See README.md in this directory.

samples.name: valid_bp_reading
samples.description: The builder's ORU^R01 for 120/80 mm[Hg], observation time in UTC.

evidence.mllp: observed in S4 (row v): a valid ORU^R01 got AA; same kind of message; this sample's exact bytes (control ID, times, some field text) were not sent. Differences: OBR-3 and the UTC offset in MSH-7 and OBX-14 are new here
evidence.https: observed in S5 ('valid'): a valid ORU^R01 got AA; same kind of message; this sample's exact bytes (control ID, times, some field text) were not sent. Differences as for MLLP

segments: OBR|1||SYN-VALID-0001^CUFFSIM|85354-9^Blood pressure panel with all children optional^LN|||20261113205329+0000

samples.name: valid_bp_reading_offset
samples.description: The builder's ORU^R01 for 135/85 mm[Hg] observed at 15:53:29 -0500 (US Eastern), to exercise time zone handling in the mapper.

evidence.mllp: inferred: S4 found the store does not check field content, so an OBX-14 offset should not matter
evidence.https: inferred: S5 stored a made-up message with OBX-14 offset -0500, but did not record its ACK

segments: OBR|1||SYN-VALID-0002^CUFFSIM|85354-9^Blood pressure panel with all children optional^LN|||20261113155329-0500

evidence_note: Each sample's 'evidence' gives, per transport it can be sent on, where its expected store outcome comes from. 'observed in S4' / 'observed in S5' means that spike sent a message with the same defect over that transport and recorded the reply; the spike's message was not byte-identical to the sample. 'inferred:' means no spike sent that defect over that transport, and says what the expectation rests on.
